Container.Name: appstore-analytics
Container.Overview: Self-hosted analytics pipeline and glassmorphic web dashboard for Google Play Store (via GCS reports) and Apple App Store (via App Store Connect API). Visualizes installs, uninstalls, active devices, and country breakdowns with Grafana-style date range controls.
Container.Description: Self-hosted analytics pipeline and glassmorphic web dashboard for Google Play Store (via GCS reports) and Apple App Store (via App Store Connect API). Visualizes installs, uninstalls, active devices, and country breakdowns with Grafana-style date range controls.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: The web interface host port mapped to container port 3000.

Config.Name: Appdata Directory
Config.Description: Main host path for persistent files (config.json, API keys, and cached stats). Ensure ownership is set to 1000:1000 (chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/appstore-analytics).

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Secret key used for signing JWT authentication tokens. Set to a secure random string.

Config.Name: Config File Path
Config.Description: Internal path to the config.json configuration file.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Internal directory path where app data is stored.
